details: A long-standing firmware flaw in Coldcard hardware wallets has reportedly led to approximately $89 million in user losses. Bloomberg ETF analyst Eric Balchunas suggests this incident strengthens the argument for regulated spot Bitcoin ETFs, highlighting their institutional custody protection as a safer alternative to self-custody.
title: Coldcard Wallet Flaw Boosts Bull Case for Bitcoin ETFs

details: Trump Media has clarified that a $165 million Bitcoin transfer to Crypto.com was not a sale. This statement comes amid ongoing scrutiny surrounding former President Trump's cryptocurrency ventures.
title: Trump Media Clarifies $165M Bitcoin Transfer to Crypto.com

details: A new Russian decree has prohibited cryptocurrency mining activities across the Moscow region, with the ban set to remain in effect until 2032. This regulatory action indicates a tightening stance on crypto operations within the area.
title: Russia Bans Crypto Mining in Moscow Region Through 2032

details: An Iran-linked exchange is reported to have transferred $676 million to Binance wallets in an alleged operation to evade sanctions. This event underscores persistent regulatory challenges and concerns regarding illicit financial flows in the crypto sector.
title: Iran-Linked Exchange Allegedly Sent $676M to Binance

details: The Bank for International Settlements (BIS) has successfully completed trials for its Project Agorá, settling $1 million in tokenized cross-border payments. This achievement highlights the potential for central bank digital currencies (CBDCs) and tokenized assets in streamlining international transactions.
title: BIS Project Agorá Settles $1M in Tokenized Cross-Border Payments

details: Bitcoin Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs) have recorded $233 million in inflows, pushing their weekly performance back into positive territory. This surge suggests renewed institutional interest and a positive shift in investor sentiment toward Bitcoin.
title: Bitcoin ETFs See $233M Inflows, Weekly Performance Green

details: New York authorities have filed a lawsuit against Kalshi, an event-based prediction market, accusing it of operating an illegal gambling scheme. This legal action highlights the ongoing regulatory uncertainties faced by prediction markets and potentially broader implications for similar crypto projects.
title: New York Sues Kalshi Over Alleged Illegal Gambling Operation

details: The decentralized lending protocol Aave is evaluating a proposal to close six of its V3 blockchain markets and offboard 50 low-use reserves. This strategic move aims to optimize resource allocation and enhance the overall efficiency of the protocol.
title: Aave Considers Closing 6 V3 Blockchain Markets
